accepts.because: a question for this agent core -- a consult or a lookup. `context.consult_class` picks the model tier when the caller promotes it; without it the default tier answers, so the lane demands no context of its own
one tool result, coming back from a tool cell the parent wired. The core runs its OWN tool round, so the round is only closable if the results can come home
a memory bundle, coming back from whatever keeps this agent's memory. R-CG-1 moved the memory leg off the talkies onto this collector, so this is the lane its answer arrives on

emits.because: the core's answer, for whoever asked. Since collector@2.1.1 a THIRD sort travels here and it is told apart by `hop.degraded`, not by `round_capped` (which such a message does not carry): a turn that could not be assembled at all because the store refused a read or a write (GH #343). `hop.store_error` carries the store's `error_code`, `hop.store_operation` the op it refused, and the text names both. A parent that renders an answer must branch on `degraded` -- without it a failure reads as a real reply

a tool call for a cell the parent wired; hop.tool_name says which one. `escalate_to_deep` is reserved and never leaves -- it is this composite's own lane between the two brains. Since cogny@4.0.2 the exit is a GUARDED DEFAULT edge (GH #283, ruling Q1) instead of the negation chain it shipped as: `{"from": "./dispatcher", "to": ".", "default": true, "condition": "has(hop.route) && hop.route == 'tool'"}`. The reserved name is now held by the ordinary edge that always claimed it, and an ordinary edge that fires silences the default for that message -- so the exclusion term `(!has(hop.tool_name) || hop.tool_name != 'escalate_to_deep')` is gone rather than merely shorter, and a SECOND reserved name costs one ordinary edge and no change here at all. Behaviour is unchanged for every message this composite can produce. The guard is not decoration: ./dispatcher emits four sorts (calls, result, answer, tool) and suppression is SENDER-WIDE, so an unguarded default would try to carry calls/result/answer outward whenever nothing ordinary fired for them. And the no-tee requirement holds at this tree: ./dispatcher has five out-edges (calls, result, answer and escalate_to_deep into ./collector, plus this one), each conditioned on its own lane, and there is NO unconditional tee -- one added later would silence this default for every tool call. The sender inventory of the whole composite, for the same reason: five senders (., ./collector, ./brain, ./brain_fast, ./dispatcher) over 17 edges, four of which reach `.` -- and the sender-wide rule counts an edge a PARENT draws from ./cogny/dispatcher too
a memory read this turn needs; `memory_tier` on ./collector/assemble decides how deep it asks
a failed inference on either brain, normalised onto one lane by the exit edge itself -- this composite carries no errors cell. The parent MUST wire it -- unwired it dead-letters, loudly

edges.condition: has(hop.route) && hop.route == 'brain' && has(hop.iter) && int(hop.iter) < 12 && has(context.consult_class) && context.consult_class == 'lookup'

description.purpose: Scope marker of the cogny composite: the agent core as ONE hive - the proven tool-loop core (collector fan-in, dispatcher fan-out, a thinking brain) behind ONE consult ingress and ONE advice exit. Since 3.0.1 five further lanes meet at the same path (GH #240): in_tool and in_bundle in, tool, recall and error out, so the tool round it is built around can actually call something, the memory leg R-CG-1 put on this collector has somewhere to ask, and a failed inference on either brain leaves on one normalised lane instead of dead-lettering. Its own seam, its own iteration bound, its own restore_ttl. Since 1.1.0 the seam has TWO lanes (GH #124): the same assembled errand goes to ./brain or to ./brain_fast, decided by context.consult_class, so a lookup never queues behind a research answer in one serial mailbox. No keeper, no summarizer, no proxy: the core has no channel, no sessions and no night, so nothing here mints an id or closes a day.
description.use_when: One per agent, never one per channel voice. Instantiate it as a SIBLING of the talkies and wire the two advisor ports plus the tool, memory and error lanes in the same mutation; the composite is an island until an edge crosses into it. The lookup lane needs nothing extra to exist - it needs the ingress edge of the second tool name to set context.consult_class, and without that every errand takes the deep lane exactly as before.
description.not_in_scope: No tool cells (they are wired per instance on hop.tool_name), no memory hive, no channel surface, no session lifecycle, and no errors cell -- the two brains are joined onto the error lane by the exit edges' own set_hop.route. The core's identity, instructions and tool schemas live in the brains' own cell.db - the composite carries the topology, never the persona; the ONE exception is the `brevity` system slot of ./brain_fast, which is the lane's length discipline and therefore topology. The class is not decided here either: an edge outside this hive reads the tool name the asking model chose.
